title: Add browser smoke suite for Persian UI
description: Verify representative Persian routes render correct direction, localized text, accessible layout, and functional controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Persian routes set `lang=fa` and `dir=rtl` on the document root
Navigation, forms, tables, dialogs, status, and errors are readable without horizontal overflow at representative widths
Keyboard and focus checks work in Persian as in English
Persian and English smoke suites use the same functional assertions

steps.details: Run the representative login/dashboard/node/tunnel/settings flow under `/fa` and capture direction, text, overflow, and control failures.
Read root layout, locale routing, shared components, catalogs, and physical CSS utilities; map only concrete failures.
Use logical CSS properties and localized strings while preserving the English layout and existing brand styling.
Run the full representative Persian suite at desktop/mobile, then typecheck/lint/custom tests.

technicalNotes: The user explicitly requires Persian documentation and UI; do not treat it as optional.
